items.Sentence: The headworks include a rotary hydroscreen system, a screenings washer, and a metering flume.

Wastewater from the headworks flows by gravity to the east end of the aeration pond. The pond has a volumetric capacity of 2.93 million gallons, and is divided into three baffled cells... The first cell contains two 7.5- horsepower aerators that run continuously... the third cell contains a 3- horsepower aerator, set on a timer, to create aerobic and anoxic conditions within the pond.
The settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage during high flows and for filter backwashes.

Tertiary treatment is achieved in the microfiltration system. The microfiltration system consists of two treatment trains each with a holding tank, strainer, and three banks of 12 microza microfiltration modules...

To maintain cleanliness in the filters, the secondary effluent is pre- chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite prior to filtration... Sodium hypochlorite is stored in a 540-gallon tank and is conveyed to the injection point through a 1-inch line by a pair of peristaltic pumps.
After flowing through the chlorine contact tank, before discharge to the effluent storage pond, the chlorinated effluent is dechlorinated using sodium bisulfite.
Biosolids generated during the treatment process accumulate in the aeration and settling ponds, where they undergo anaerobic digestion and densification.
During the 2012 biosolids removal event, approximately 99 dry tons of solids were removed from the ponds and land applied by Synagro Technologies, Inc.
The cleaned and dewatered solids are disposed of at a landfill.
A chlorine gas system was replaced with a sodium hypochlorite system in May 2014.
The Permittee is also planning to acquire funding for an addition onto the existing filtration unit to increase treatment capacity and reduce the wear on the filtration unit as a whole.
